column3: The identity is structure-derived as in BootUI 2.4.0 AdvisorFindingIdentity.java (no line number, never from the order of observation), but in sharpit's own plain form <path>:<scope qualified name>:<Type>#<n>/<m>, at most 512 characters, with no "v1:" version prefix and no percent-encoding (deviation, proposed): the dismissedFindings store of 0.4.0 to 0.6.0 already holds plain identities, n is the position of the clause among the swallowing clauses of its scope and m their count, so a clause added, removed or logged changes every key of the scope (a dismissal comes back, it never moves). BootUI 2.4.0 CaughtOutcomes keys its site by line (CaughtOutcomes.java:746-748), so it does not settle this design. Reason: Python scope names and the earlier line-keyed form make a versioned, encoded key a breaking change with no gain.
